name: hero
whatItDemonstrates: A 'Favorite' heart button that swaps between filled and outline heart icons based on its pressed state, using the render prop to return a different native <button> per state.
stateManaged: uncontrolled — no `pressed`/`defaultPressed` prop and no React state in the demo; Toggle manages the pressed state internally (starts unpressed) and the render prop re-renders from its `state.pressed` argument
nonTrivialInteractions: The render prop receives (props, state) and returns a different native <button type="button"> depending on state.pressed — filled heart icon when pressed, outline heart icon otherwise — spreading Toggle's returned props onto each

Pressed-state styling is driven by the `data-pressed` attribute (Tailwind `data-pressed:` variant; CSS module `[data-pressed]` selector), while hover/active/focus-visible states are qualified with not-data-disabled so a disabled toggle stays visually inert
aria-label="Favorite" is passed through to the rendered button for accessible labeling; the rendered element is a real <button>, so the documented `nativeButton` default (true) applies unchanged
